# Indicator Calculation 

## HFIAS

```{r food-rescale}
# Set number of days to 0 if households have not experienced a form of food insecurity
food_add0 <- function(food_var, random_number_food = main$food_number_of_days) {
  last_char <- substr(cur_column(), nchar(cur_column()), nchar(cur_column()))
  food_a <- main[[paste0(sub(last_char, "a", cur_column()))]]
  
  if (last_char == "b") {
    case_when(
      random_number_food == 7 & food_a == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ food_var)
  } else if (last_char == "c") {
    case_when(
      random_number_food == 30 & food_a == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ food_var)
  }
}

# Set number of days to 0 if households have not experienced a form of food insecurity
main <- main %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Food") & (ends_with("b") | ends_with("c")) & names(.)[nchar(names(.)) == 7], ~ food_add0(as.numeric(.x))))

# Rescale values from 7 to 30 day recall period
food_rescale_7_30 <- function(food_c, variant = 1) {
  
  if (variant == 1) {
  case_when(
    food_c == 0 ~ 0,
    food_c %in% c(1) ~ 1,
    food_c %in% c(2,3) ~ 2,
    food_c %in% c(4,5,6,7) ~ 3)
  } else if (variant == 2) {
  case_when(
    food_c == 0 ~ 0,
    food_c %in% c(1,2) ~ 1,
    food_c %in% c(3,4) ~ 2,
    food_c %in% c(5,6,7) ~ 3)
  } else if (variant == 3) {
  case_when(
    food_c == 0 ~ 0,
    food_c %in% c(1,2) ~ 1,
    food_c %in% c(3,4,5) ~ 2,
    food_c %in% c(6,7) ~ 3)
  }
}

main <- main %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Food") & ends_with("c") & names(.)[nchar(names(.)) == 7], ~ food_rescale_7_30(.x, variant = 2), .names = "{str_replace(.col, 'c', 'b')}Rescaled"))

# For test purposes - consider removing
main <- main %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Food") & ends_with("c") & names(.)[nchar(names(.)) == 7], ~ food_rescale_7_30(.x, variant = 1), .names = "{str_replace(.col, 'c', 'b')}RescaledV1"))
main <- main %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Food") & ends_with("c") & names(.)[nchar(names(.)) == 7], ~ food_rescale_7_30(.x, variant = 3), .names = "{str_replace(.col, 'c', 'b')}RescaledV3"))

# Combine original and rescaled values in 30 day recall period
food_combine_30 <- function(food_b) {
  food_bRescaled <- main[[paste0(cur_column(), "Rescaled")]]
  
  case_when(
    is.na(food_b) & !is.na(food_bRescaled) ~ food_bRescaled,
    !is.na(food_b) & is.na(food_bRescaled) ~ food_b)
}
main <- main %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Food") & ends_with("b") & names(.)[nchar(names(.)) == 7], ~ food_combine_30(.x), .names = "{.col}Combined"))

# Rescale values from 30 to 7 day recall period
food_rescale_30_7 <- function(food_b) {
  food_b * 7/3
}

main <- main %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Food") & ends_with("b") & names(.)[nchar(names(.)) == 7], ~ food_rescale_30_7(.x), .names = "{str_replace(.col, 'b', 'c')}Rescaled"))

# Combine original and rescaled values in 7 day recall period
food_combine_7 <- function(food_c) {
  food_cRescaled <- main[[paste0(cur_column(), "Rescaled")]]
  
  case_when(
    is.na(food_c) & !is.na(food_cRescaled) ~ food_cRescaled,
    !is.na(food_c) & is.na(food_cRescaled) ~ food_c)
}

main <- main %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Food") & ends_with("c") & names(.)[nchar(names(.)) == 7], ~ food_combine_7(.x), .names = "{.col}Combined"))
```

```{r HFIAS}
label_fds <- function(df = ., col_name, label_string, prefixFalse = "No", add_labels = TRUE, false_label = NULL) {
  labels <- c(label_string, paste0(prefixFalse, " ", tolower(substr(label_string, 1, 1)), substr(label_string, 2, nchar(label_string))))
  
  if (!is.null(false_label)) {
    labels[2] <- false_label
  }

  if (add_labels == TRUE) {
    df <- df %>%
      mutate({{col_name}} := labelled({{col_name}},
                                      label = label_string,
                                      setNames(1:2, labels)))
  } else if (add_labels == FALSE) {
    df <- df %>%
      mutate({{col_name}} := labelled({{col_name}},
                                      label = label_string))
  }

  return(df)
}

# Sum values for HFIAS
HFIASOrig_vars <- c("Food01b", "Food02b", "Food03b", "Food04b", "Food06b", "Food08b", "Food09b", "Food10b", "Food11b")
HFIASRescaled_vars <- paste0(HFIASOrig_vars, "Rescaled")
HFIASRescaledV3_vars <- paste0(HFIASOrig_vars, "RescaledV3")
HFIASRescaledV1_vars <- paste0(HFIASOrig_vars, "RescaledV1")
HFIASCombined_vars <- paste0(HFIASOrig_vars, "Combined")

main <- main |>
  mutate(
    HFIASOrig = Reduce(`+`, across(all_of(HFIASOrig_vars))),
    HFIASRescaled = Reduce(`+`, across(all_of(HFIASRescaled_vars))),
    HFIASRescaledV3 = Reduce(`+`, across(all_of(HFIASRescaledV3_vars))),
    HFIASCombined = Reduce(`+`, across(all_of(HFIASCombined_vars)))
   ) |>
label_fds(HFIASOrig, "Household Food Insecurity Access Scale Score (non-rescaled values only)", add_labels = FALSE) |>
  label_fds(HFIASRescaled, "Household Food Insecurity Access Scale Score (rescaled values only)", add_labels = FALSE) |>
  label_fds(HFIASCombined, "Household Food Insecurity Access Scale Score (combined values)", add_labels = FALSE)


# Create HFIA categories based on conditions
HFIA_cat <- function(df, varName) {
  if (varName == "Orig") {
    vars <- HFIASOrig_vars
  } else if (varName == "Rescaled") {
    vars <- HFIASRescaled_vars
  } else if (varName == "Combined") {
    vars <- HFIASCombined_vars
  }
  
  varCat1 <- paste0("HFIA", varName, "Cat1")
  varCat2 <- paste0("HFIA", varName, "Cat2")
  varCat3 <- paste0("HFIA", varName, "Cat3")
  varCat4 <- paste0("HFIA", varName, "Cat4")
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      !!varCat1 := case_when(
        get(vars[1]) %in% c(0, 1) & get(vars[2]) == 0 & get(vars[3]) == 0 & 
          get(vars[4]) == 0 & get(vars[5]) == 0 & get(vars[6]) == 0 & 
          get(vars[7]) == 0 & get(vars[8]) == 0 & get(vars[9]) == 0 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_)) |>
    mutate(
      !!varCat2 := case_when(
        (get(vars[1]) %in% c(2, 3) | get(vars[2])  %in% c(1, 2, 3) | get(vars[3])  == 1 | get(vars[4])  == 1) & 
          get(vars[5]) == 0 & get(vars[6]) == 0 & get(vars[7]) == 0 & get(vars[8]) == 0 & get(vars[9]) == 0 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_)) |>
    mutate(
      !!varCat3 := case_when(
        (get(vars[3]) %in% c(2, 3) | get(vars[4]) %in% c(2, 3) | get(vars[5]) %in% c(1, 2) | get(vars[6]) %in% c(1, 2)) &
          get(vars[7]) == 0 & get(vars[8]) == 0 & get(vars[9]) == 0 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_)) |>
    mutate(
      !!varCat4 := case_when(
        get(vars[5]) == 3 | get(vars[6]) == 3 | get(vars[7]) %in% c(1, 2, 3) | 
          get(vars[8]) %in% c(1, 2, 3) | get(vars[9]) %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_))
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      !!varCat1 := case_when(
        get(varCat1) == 1 & (get(varCat2) == 1 | get(varCat3) == 1 | get(varCat4) == 1) ~ 2,
        TRUE ~ get(varCat1)
      ),
      !!varCat2 := case_when(
        get(varCat2) == 1 & (get(varCat3) == 1 | get(varCat4)) == 1 ~ 2,
        TRUE ~ get(varCat2)
      ),
      !!varCat3 := case_when(
        get(varCat3) == 1 & get(varCat4) == 1 ~ 2,
        TRUE ~ get(varCat3)
      )
    )
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(across(c(!!varCat1, !!varCat2, !!varCat3, !!varCat4), 
                  ~ case_when(is.na(.) & (!is.na(get(varCat1)) | !is.na(get(varCat2)) | 
                                            !is.na(get(varCat3)) | !is.na(get(varCat4))) ~ 2,
                              TRUE ~ .))) 
  
  return(df)
}

main <- reduce(c("Orig", "Rescaled", "Combined"), ~ HFIA_cat(.x, .y), .init = main)

main <- main |>
  label_fds(HFIAOrigCat1, "Food secure (non-rescaled values only)", prefixFalse = "Not") |>
  label_fds(HFIAOrigCat2, "Mildly food insecure (non-rescaled values only)", prefixFalse = "Not") |>
  label_fds(HFIAOrigCat3, "Moderately food insecure (non-rescaled values only)", prefixFalse = "Not") |>
  label_fds(HFIAOrigCat4, "Severely food insecure (non-rescaled values only)", prefixFalse = "Not")

main <- main |>
  label_fds(HFIARescaledCat1, "Food secure (rescaled values only)", prefixFalse = "Not") |>
  label_fds(HFIARescaledCat2, "Mildly food insecure (rescaled values only)", prefixFalse = "Not") |>
  label_fds(HFIARescaledCat3, "Moderately food insecure (rescaled values only)", prefixFalse = "Not") |>
  label_fds(HFIARescaledCat4, "Severely food insecure (rescaled values only)", prefixFalse = "Not")

main <- main |>
  label_fds(HFIACombinedCat1, "Food secure (combined values)", prefixFalse = "Not") |>
  label_fds(HFIACombinedCat2, "Mildly food insecure (combined values)", prefixFalse = "Not") |>
  label_fds(HFIACombinedCat3, "Moderately food insecure (combined values)", prefixFalse = "Not") |>
  label_fds(HFIACombinedCat4, "Severely food insecure (combined values)", prefixFalse = "Not")

main <- main |>
  mutate(HFIACombinedCat = case_when(
    HFIACombinedCat1 == 1 ~ 1,
    HFIACombinedCat2 == 1 ~ 2,
    HFIACombinedCat3 == 1 ~ 3,
    HFIACombinedCat4 == 1 ~ 4
  )) |>
  mutate(HFIACombinedCat = labelled(
    HFIACombinedCat,
    label = "HFIA Category",
    labels = c("Food secure" = 1,
               "Mildly food insecure" = 2,
               "Moderately food insecure" = 3,
               "Severely food insecure" = 4) 
  ))
```
